title: Mitosis core rebuild: complete the SPEC implementation

completion_criteria.text: Preconditions 0-5 of 0116's landing order are each proven discharged by measurement, or their residual named and landed, or deferred by a recorded decision. None is assumed discharged.
MSP-1..MSP-13 of the core-rebuild SPEC are each shipped and merged to main, or retired by a recorded decision naming the reason. MSP-0 shipped as PR #15 (12053dc) and is not re-done.
The declared phase set is exactly the collapsed eight (Probe, Decompose, Prep, Execute, Integrate, Ship, Resume, Remediate) and phase-parity proves declared == calls == opts.phase both ways.
SPEC success 1: a fix-typed spec ships end to end through the collapsed phase set, its receipt observed red on base and green on branch by a deterministic verb, never asserted by a model.
SPEC success 3: every Verified: line on a mitosis-opened PR is composed from a journaled gate manifest entry with a recorded exit code; absent and BROKEN gates render --not-verified with reason.
MSP-1's budget gate holds a baseline for one real current-engine run, and a post-collapse run is measured against section 6's 3-fixed-plus-9-per-MSP budget, making 0115's falsifiers payable.
The SPEC is re-grounded and committed: every citation in sections 4, 5, 12, 14 re-verified against current mitosis.js, stale anchors corrected, and every audit validity gap closed by a decision.

spine.active_goal: Verify round 7's repairs with a round 8 gate and obtain the user's rulings on the eleven reserved questions, so the SPEC and its docket can reach READY.
spine.next_step: FRESH SESSION. Round 7 landed its repairs but carries NO verdict. Run the round 8 gate: I1-I8 against the repaired documents, one independent verifier per invariant, inheriting no verdict from round 6. In parallel, present artifacts/round7-patches/RESERVED-QUESTIONS-FOR-RULING.md and take rulings on Q1 (where an [RB] note's scope ends) and Q2 (what user-ratified means) first, since they gate the rest. Resolve none of the eleven yourself. Expect fold-time contradictions per 0240.

open_risks.text: Run the round 8 gate before treating any round 7 closure as real — 43 of 47 defects are closed on the patches' own accounting and no gate has checked a single one.
Expect contradictions that exist only in the fold rather than in any patch — round 7's K5 and K8 were each correct alone and false composed, and only the applier was positioned to see it.

Enumerate every site of a claim before editing any site — round 7 found nine more unlogged sites of the gate's own claims, each byte-identical to .pre-round5, each having survived a gate that was hunting exactly that shape.

Treat the round 6 gate report as evidence, not scripture — three of its citations proved wrong: 0197 appears nowhere in either document, its corpus figure of 236 was already 238, and its cited DOCKET:146 is an empty line.

State every corpus figure with its measurement date and the store read, never as an absolute — the count moved through 227, 233, 236, 238 and 240 within days, and it grows every time this thread records a decision.

Treat five cited record sets as un-refuted rather than cleared — D-05's 0161/0180/0183/0184/0185, D-16's eight, D-14's 0187/0213/0214, D-13's 0211 and D-11's 0127 were never opened in full by any verifier, and round 7 did not open them either.

Do not perform D-02's reclassification from OPEN to CLOSED without the user — round 7 confirmed the arithmetic fix needed no classification decision, so the reclassification stays proposed and not performed.

Treat the green-branch invariant at SPEC:497 as honored by discipline, not by the server — ruleset 19939922 requires a PR but sets zero required approvals and no required status checks, and branch protection returns 404.

key_decisions.title: A repair edits every site of a claim or it does not start, because round 5 proved site-keyed repair half-lands
Each gate red is reasoned out with its full surface area by a high-reasoning Fable subagent before any fix is written
The seven completion criteria are compressed to fit the 200-char cap, meaning preserved, none struck
The re-baseline pass amends the SPEC document only; no live codebase change
Repair rounds are gated on a fixed invariant set, and stop at NOT READY rather than declare a false green
A repair whose edits must land in two documents at once is not started unless the session can finish it
A defect fix extends beyond its planned site list to every site the planned fix would otherwise break
A decision-corpus citation names a bounded record range and the store it was read in, never an absolute count
A plugin-data store may ground a corpus claim once proven byte-identical to the _ledger ref over the cited range
A many-record two-document fold is authored in parallel as matched-pair patches and applied by a single agent
A round ends before running its gate when the gate's repairs cannot land in the same session
A repair round partitions by claim, authors read-only in parallel, and folds through one applier on a higher tier
A contradiction that exists only in the composition of two correct patches is held unlanded, never reconciled by the applier
A repair round writes its own round-level changelog, and no patch may defer it to another agent
The re-baselined SPEC is abandoned and re-written from scratch against a fresh audit, not repaired further

out_of_scope: The feat pipeline - 0110 and 0118 sequence it second, after the fix pipeline proves the effector boundary. Pipelines for refactor, perf, docs or chore - closed by 0118 (limits PIPELINES only, not the PR title type vocabulary).
Speculation depth above 1 - 0109 requires a restack proven for fix specifically. An off-the-shelf durable-execution runtime - 0108. A webhook, daemon or server for the relaunch trigger - 0119.
fileScope-only task-edge derivation - rejected by 0116 and 0120. Edges stay LSP-grounded; in-engine overlap survives as a pruning input only, never as the oracle.

Cluster-aware scheduling, and the journal's 2000-character paging through model output - fenced out by SPEC section 1 and deferred in section 13. Adding any new phase, work type or scheduler - section 1 forbids it.

Bootstrapping a target repo's test infrastructure as a side effect of shipping - closed by 0117. Mitosis deploys its own gates and authors one receipt inside an EXISTING runner; an unmet floor halts fail-closed and names verify-setup.
Re-doing MSP-0. It shipped as PR #15 (12053dc): Final review deleted, Shepherd renamed to Resume, phase-parity gate live. Verify it still holds; do not re-implement it.

Other specs are consulted ONLY as evidence for the steps 0-5 precondition audit. Implementing their unshipped work is out of scope: run-readiness-repair MSP-0..MSP-10, the two-track invariant plan, b6-harness-liveness, quiescent-advance M0-M8 (already delivered).
The predecessor thread's two open follow-ups belong to it, not here: hardening .claude/hooks/block-destructive-bash.sh, and the settings deny drift per decision 0227.
spine.last_session: 2026-08-04 round 7: eleven claim-keyed clusters authored 126 edits read-only, one Opus applier folded them byte-clean; 43 of 47 defects closed but unverified, eleven questions reserved.
